The '''Northern Alliance''' originally known as the '''The Northern Alliance against Astoria and Southern State Aggression''' is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_alliance Military alliance] that was formed to combat and ensure the security of the Theorin and Rhovlandian monarchies and the values of the old world with their allies in the political instability of the time formed in 1839 the alliance was originally just between the original 3 nations of the [[Theorin Commonwealth]], [[Imperial Rhovland]] and the [[Federation of Vinterholm]] against the growing militaristic threat of [[Legion of Astoria|Astoria]].

== Origins ==
The Origins of the Northern Alliance go back to its precursor the older [[Theorin-Vinterholm Alliance]] formed to combat eastern threats such as the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]] from invading the Western Nations, with them eventually securing alliances with Rhovland then forming the Alliance in 1839 at the [[March Conference]] with the alliance forming to share technologies, weapons and commerce to combat nations that the leaders of the alliance saw as a threat to old world values within the Western World eventually the Alliance in the 1870s backing it's political and economic in trudge into the Eastern Hemisphere to back its allies in the region the [[Gwangyanski Kingdom]], [[Arashyurt Duchy]] and [[Mongilov Federation]] then forming the basis of the alliance as we see it today.

== Throughout History ==
[[File:SvetianWar1.jpg|thumb|Theorin troops durning the Battle of Kaplan Ridge in 1882.]]
[[File:SvetianWar2.jpg|thumb|Rhovlandian Seabattalion on the March to Murah.]]
The Alliance first and most prominiant military action was in the [[Svetian War]] of 1880-1884 against the Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate and the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]] this was to secure the resources in the region and to deny the Volgastani-Hamed Empire and  Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate those resources and to have control of the Svetian People and Lands this was in collaboration with the [[Vesperan Empire]] to weaken Volgastani power in the region the [[5 Nation Alliance]] defeating the Volgastani-Arbogradsk Armies in the Decisive Battle of Kaplan Ridge in 1882 and eventually defeating the [[Volgastani-Arabogradsk Alliance]] in 1884, Forcing the nations to pay war reparations, the establishment of a diplomatic quarter in the capital of Murah.


This would all coincide with the Volgastani Summer Revolution in 1891 with the discontent of the populous over the embarrassing defeat of the Empire, Economic and Social Issues compelled in the [[Siege of Murah]] where the [[Green Turban Rebels]] being anti-foreign besieged the city for 71 days with most of the representatives, businessmen and merchants of Theorin, Vinterholm, Rhovland, Gwangyanski, Aurendale, Vesperan, Solara and Astoria being trapped within with the Rebels killing foreigners on sight. this accumulated in a temporary emergency alliance proposed by the Northern Alliance named "'''[[The International Relief Alliance]]'''" with the 8 Nations sending troops to extract their people's this was worked in tandem with the [[Volgastani-Hamed Royal Army]] to defend the city for those 71 days eventually with the relief force arriving and extracting all peoples from the city.
